heterogeneity.variance: For each context, folio-cluster delta-method MH variance m/(m-1)*sum_p(Np-RD*Dp)^2/(sum Dp)^2, m all covered event pages. Report percentile folio-bootstrap CIs separately. Zero variance/undefined effects => NOT ESTIMABLE, no smoothing.
heterogeneity.Q: Cochran Q inverse cluster-variance weights about overall fixed-effect mean. Recompute RD and cluster variance for every shuffle. Whole folio labels shuffled within scribe, fixed context counts. 10000 seeded shuffles with plus-one p. Undefined shuffle invalidates permutation test rather than dropping it.
heterogeneity.REML: Restricted normal likelihood, tau2>=0; Q-profile interval solves Q(tau2)=chi-square quantiles df=k-1, truncate at zero. I2=max(0,(Q-df)/Q). Variance in squared probability units; effect/CI points in report.
heterogeneity.sensitivities: Scribe2 C1-C3; scribe2 without C1 C2-C3. Selection of C1/C4 retained and labeled.
heterogeneity.controls: 200 independently generated outcomes per homogeneous null .20, homogeneous positive .20+.08*sh, heterogeneous positive .20+.12*sh in C1 only. Same real geometry and folio permutations. Null and homogeneous-positive Wilson upper<=.05; heterogeneous power descriptive only. No gates retuned.
heterogeneity.bootstrap: 4999 folio resamples; 2.5/97.5 percentile; pooled H/F prohibited. Ratio uses identical draws for available and aggregate. Zero-denominator replicates retained as invalid count; warn if aggregate CI spans zero.

interpretation: Retrospective structural association only. A Currier-A pass supports cross-variety association in these samples, not proof of a scribe-independent habit. Selection, sparse contexts and within-scribe test limits remain explicit.
